card.name: Book publication and editions
card.fires_on: Words in literary biography and bibliography text about how a book was published or reissued, such as republished, reprinted, editions, paperback, and the 'as' or 'in' after 'published'.

modes.label: Edition and format words
modes.description: Nouns naming a version of a book, like editions or paperback.
modes.example: Page numbers refer to the Perennial Classics 2003<< paperback>> edition of Our Town.

modes.label: Re-publishing verbs
modes.description: Parts of verbs about issuing a work again, such as republished or reprinted.
modes.example: was re<<printed>> with variants and notes by Alphonse

modes.label: Linking word after published
modes.description: Small words like 'as' or 'in' following published or available, before a title, year or language.

card.writes: It pushes toward publishing-related words like publication and publisher (including Chinese 出版社).
card.plain: It lights up on words about a book being published, reprinted or issued in an edition.
